summary: Two clinics and a clear veneers offer are strengths, but wrong copy on the veneers page and several booking paths appear to cost you cosmetic patients.

findings.problem: The veneers page describes veneers as thin, custom made implants, and a line about orthodontists, brackets and bands appears to be braces copy pasted onto the page.
findings.cost: Wrong facts on a cosmetic page confuse patients and weaken trust.

findings.problem: Typos include 'Prior the placement of your veneers', 'Are there Alternative to Veneers' and an image named Dental-Venners.png.
findings.cost: Spelling errors reduce trust in cosmetic work.

findings.problem: Book In CBD Now, Book Your Appointment, Request Booking and Contact Us Today go to different places and no booking form appears on the page.
findings.cost: Mixed booking paths lose patients who were ready to book.
findings.fix: One booking path with a form and WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The page shows no testimonials, before and after examples, pricing or dentist credentials, and a link slug points to Surry Hills although it is not a listed clinic.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients decide on proof and see none.
findings.fix: Captioned cases, reviews and named dentists.

redesign: Accurate veneers copy and a captioned results gallery.
One booking path with a form and WhatsApp.
Named dentists, reviews and clear pricing guidance.
